market.question: Will the highest temperature in Los Angeles be between 68-69°F on May 2?

assessment.reasoning: LA forecast for May 2 is around 77°F high (early-May average ~77.5°F). Question requires high to land in the narrow 68-69°F bucket — that's 8-9°F below forecast. Would need an unusual cool marine layer day.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Onshore flow / June gloom-style cooling that could occur in early May.
